description: Start here to make photos. Returns a link for the user to open: they sign in to DatingProfile (or sign up, free, with email or Google) and upload a selfie there (one is enough; up to 4 give a closer likeness), which also runs the free photo check. Also returns a connection_key: keep it for every account tool in this conversation and never show it to the user. Only call this once per conversation unless the key stops working.
name: connect_account
title: Connect a DatingProfile account
